excluded_material: S6 semantic-admission packages v1, v2, and v3
retained live responses and effect evidence

construction_boundary.method: clean-room manual semantic derivation from accepted public authority
construction_boundary.input_style: neutral self-contained source-passage objects with passage and span identities or candidate inputs, raw provider claim/proposal or abstention payloads, bounded observations, local condition facts, structural or policy defect bytes, and explicit missing/deleted payload facts; no real mod, fixture, file, or record names and no expected axis or host-decision labels in product inputs
construction_boundary.expected_truth_source: accepted semantic rules applied to independently authored raw case relationships; every source claim citation resolves to exactly one identified span before faithful extraction is authorable, unknown citations are structural failures, and deleted cases resolve exact byte-length and SHA-256 bindings to oracle-only pre-deletion material excluded from raw product input
construction_boundary.self_contained_relationships: Each live source case contains its neutral passage_id, span_id, span text, provider claim or abstention payload, and citation relationship. The deleted source case binds exact pre-deletion passage-object and provider bytes and a prior receipt naming the same passage_id, span_id, and provider citation.

required_boundaries: faithful source extraction is not downstream truth
candidate proposal is not host authority
source citations resolve to exactly one bound passage span
unknown source citations are structurally rejected
unsupported is insufficient support rather than false
